screens.title: A modern, high-fidelity UI dashboard for a B2B SaaS learning management system named SkillPass. The interface shows a list of safety training courses (industrial safety, fire safety) with colorful icons, circular progress bars indicating completion percentage, and a clean sidebar navigation. The color palette is professional with corporate blue (#006CB5) and bright cyan (#35C5F4) accents on a clean white background. Minimalist design, soft shadows, Montserrat typography. The view is a perspective or front-facing shot of a web application screen.
